title: Vintage AFTER SHOCK Get Crystallized Black Adjustable Hat Embroidered - Poor
descriptionText:
Very poor condition. Has splotches of white paint. SEE PICS!

This vintage AFTER SHOCK hat is a must-have for any collector. The black embroidered design is eye-catching and unique, featuring the phrase "Get Crystallized". The hat is made of cotton and is suitable for any season, whether it's winter, summer, fall, or spring. 

It's a baseball cap with an adjustable strap, making it suitable for any head size. The hat is perfect for casual occasions and fits well with any vintage-themed outfit. This item is ideal for men who love vintage accessories and want to add a unique piece to their collection.
